about.intro_content: Prof. Min-Shan Chen is Chief Physician of the Department of Liver Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, where he leads a multidisciplinary team (MDT) for the diagnosis and treatment of liver cancer.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Chen's MDT provides individualised case management using laparoscopic and robotic-assisted hepatectomy, thermal ablation, and transarterial intervention. He has published more than 100 papers as corresponding or first author, six of which have been cited in NCCN guidelines for liver cancer, and has been recognised as a Highly Cited Researcher by Elsevier. He is Principal Investigator on multiple multicentre studies in hepatocellular carcinoma and has received more than 10 national research grants.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Min-Shan Chen

items.question: Does Prof. Min-Shan Chen accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to liver cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Chen's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Chen specialises in the multidisciplinary treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma, including minimally invasive surgery, thermal ablation and transarterial intervention.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Chen's research reflected in international treatment guidelines?
items.answer: Yes. Six of Prof. Chen's published studies are cited directly in the NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines for hepatocellular carcinoma.

items.question: What treatment options does Prof. Chen's team offer for liver cancer?
items.answer: Prof. Chen's multidisciplinary team offers laparoscopic and robotic-assisted hepatectomy, radiofrequency ablation, and transarterial chemoembolisation, tailored to tumour size, location and liver function.
